risk_register.label: AI accuracy and hallucination risk

risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK AI Bill 2026 — accuracy and transparency obligations

risk_register.label: Ethical and bias risk

risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK Equality Act 2010 — protected characteristics in automated decision-making
fashion_extensions_applied: Sizing bias — AI sizing recommendations trained primarily on standard UK size data may underserve plus-size, petite or non-standard body types who represent a majority of real customers
Fast-fashion sustainability — AI demand forecasting optimised purely for sell-through rate may conflict with the business's sustainability commitments or consumer expectations around overconsumption

phase2_deploy_built.title: Automated Review Collection
phase2_deploy_built.justification: Lucy & Yak can leverage Automated Review Collection to improve customer engagement and brand authenticity by automating the review collection process, which is particularly relevant given their primary challenge of maintaining brand authenticity.

deliverables.name: configuration_guide_yotpo
deliverables.content: To configure Yotpo on Lucy & Yak's Shopify store, navigate to the Apps section in the Shopify dashboard and search for 'Yotpo'. Click 'Get' to install the app, then follow the setup wizard to connect your store and configure review collection settings. Be sure to set up a post-purchase email sequence that asks customers to leave a photo review, timed to arrive once the item has likely been worn.
deliverables.instructions: Configuration guide for Yotpo, ranked #1 for this business.

Judge.me's lightweight and budget-friendly approach aligns with Lucy & Yak's need for a cost-effective review collection solution.

roadmap.title: Remediate HIGH-severity risks: Vendor Risk
roadmap.description: Address vendor risk by implementing a returns management platform to reduce refund leakage and provide structured returns data.

tasks.task: Research and shortlist returns management platforms
Implement Loop Returns or Klaviyo + Mailchimp dual deployment

recommendations.name: Loop Returns
recommendations.description: Converts refunds into exchanges, suggests alternative products, and provides structured returns data.

recommendations.name: Klaviyo + Mailchimp dual deployment
recommendations.description: Runs primary email flows in Klaviyo while maintaining a Mailchimp backup list.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Loop Returns
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Returns management platform for Shopify merchants that converts refunds into exchanges. When a customer initiates a return, Loop suggests alternative products, different sizes, or store credit. Directly reduces refund leakage for fashion brands with high size-related return rates. Provides structured returns data as a byproduct.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Klaviyo + Mailchimp dual deployment
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Not a single tool but a strategy: running primary email flows in Klaviyo while maintaining a Mailchimp backup list ensures no single marketing automation vendor holds all customer communication. Both export subscriber lists in standard CSV — satisfying Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 portability requirements.
recommended_ai_agents.estimated_monthly_cost_gbp: Mailchimp free up to 500 contacts. Klaviyo free up to 250 contacts

roi_summary: Lucy & Yak can expect to see significant commercial benefits from implementing the full roadmap over 12 weeks. Phase 1 (weeks 1-2) will deliver a 15% increase in reviews through Automated Review Collection, while also capturing returns reasons with Returns Reason Capture, resulting in improved customer insights and reduced returns rates. Email Marketing Automation Flows will be implemented in phase 2 (weeks 3-4), driving an estimated £10,000 additional annual revenue. Phase 3 (weeks 5-6) will see the introduction of a Size Guide Chatbot, reducing size-related returns by up to 25%. The WhatsApp Styling Assistant will be launched in phase 4 (weeks 7-8), potentially generating an additional £12,000 annual revenue through increased sales conversions. Finally, AI Demand Forecasting and Dynamic Pricing Engine will be implemented in phase 5 (weeks 9-12), resulting in a further £20,000 annual revenue boost.
